comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) map by key later; V1 shows captions only. Specific-key entries (e.g. 'road.enter.Windward Road') are checked before the generic fallback ('road.enter') — add per-road and per-landmark flavour lines here with no TypeScript changes needed.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
Airport to Ochi — one road, pure adventure. Leh wi go!
Drive on di LEFT, always on di LEFT — dis is Jamaica, not America!
Fasten yuh seat belt and leave di noise behind — Jamaica a-call!
Norman Manley International done — di real journey start now, star!
road.enter: {road} ahead — smooth or rough, Jamaica nah stop!
road.enter.Norman Manley Highway / Palis: Di Palisadoes! Government keep dis road smooth — enjoy it while it last!
Sea on every side — harbour to di left, open Caribbean to di right. Pure Jamaica!
Airport road clean clean — dem nuh want tourist see pothole before dem reach Kingston!
road.enter.Sir Florizel Glaspole Bouleva: Harbour View junction — Kingston proper is next. Ready yourself!
Leavin' di Palisadoes — di city coming fast. Drive wid yuh eyes open!
road.enter.Windward Road: Windward Road — welcome to di capital! Kingston alive and breathing right yah so!
Kingston! Every man, woman and pickney on Windward Road — look sharp!
road.enter.Mountain View Avenue: Mountain View! National Stadium right deh — di track where Jamaican greatness born!
Excelsior High School cross di road from di stadium — champions on every corner!
road.enter.Hope Road: Hope Road! Fifty-Six Hope Road just round di corner — one love from di Tuff Gong himself!
Hope Road — di most famous address in reggae. Bob walk these very streets, brethren.
road.enter.Hagley Park Road: Hagley Park — Half Way Tree right ahead! Every taxi, every bus, every duppy pass through here!
Di Half Way Tree crossroads comin' up — been di centre a Kingston life since colonial time!
road.enter.Eastwood Park Road: Eastwood Park — Half Way Tree just seconds away!
road.enter.Spanish Town Road: Spanish Town Road — leavin' Kingston behind, heading west through history!
Spanish Town Road, star — dis road carry everyone who ever leave Kingston fi di country!
road.enter.Nelson Mandela Highway: Nelson Mandela Highway — smooth bypass, but di real Jamaica waiting on di other side!
Bypass road — named after di great man himself. Drive wid respect!
road.enter.Sligoville Road: Hill country starting — Sligoville Road wind up into di St. Catherine hills!
Climbing now — di Blue Mountains behind, Spanish Town below. Pure Jamaica heartland!
road.enter.Bog Walk Gorge: Bog Walk Gorge! Rio Cobre running wild below — limestone cliffs on every side!
Di gorge close in — nuh panic, di road know where it going. Trust it!
Flat Bridge ahead inna di gorge — one lane, nuh railings. Most exciting bridge in Jamaica!
road.enter.Bogwalk Gorge Road: Still deep in di gorge — Rio Cobre right beside yuh, green and rushing!
Gorge walls high, road narrow — dis is Bog Walk brethren, nuh joke wid it!
road.enter.River Road: River Road — Rio Cobre flowing alongside, fresh and green. Jamaica at its finest!
Follow di river — Rio Cobre show yuh the way out di gorge!
road.enter.Linstead Bypass: Linstead! Market town, famous from song — carry mi ackee go a Linstead market!
Linstead bypass — ackee and saltfish territory right yah so!
road.enter.Linstead - Moneague Road: Country road now — di goat dem might cross any moment. Watch yuhself!
Linstead to Moneague — hill country climbing, free-range animals everywhere. Slow down!
road.enter.Moneague - Ocho Rios Road: From Moneague heading north — di road drop down toward di coast! Faith's Pen coming!
North coast road — Ocho Rios getting closer wid every bend. Almost deh, brethren!
road.enter.Milford Road: Fern Gully! Di most famous road in Jamaica — green tunnel fi di ages!
Milford Road — every Jamaican call it Fern Gully. Drive slow and tek it in, dis is special!
Three kilometre of pure canopy — bamboo and fern above, cool shade below. Nuh rush through dis!
Welcome to Fern Gully — nature put on a show right here. Slow down, breathe, give thanks!
road.enter.Ocho Rios Bypass: Ochi bypass — di town itself just below! Sea and sunshine waiting!
Almost reach Dunn's River — di end of di road is right here!
road.enter.Northern Coastal Highway: Northern Coastal Highway — Ocho Rios just ahead! Yuh nearly done it!
Sea breeze fresh on di north coast — Ochi waiting fi yuh. Keep pushing!
Final stretch from Airport to Ochi — look how far yuh reach, star. Respect yuhself!
landmark.enter: {landmark} — real Jamaican landmark right deh so!
landmark.enter.Gun Boat Beach: Gun Boat Beach! Harbour side, coconut tree swaying — dis is di Jamaica postcards lie about!
Gunboat Beach — soldiers anchor here long time. Now is pure beach vibes and coconut water!
landmark.enter.National Stadium: National Stadium! Usain Bolt and di whole a Jamaica sprint off dis very track!
Di National Stadium — where Jamaica show di world what speed look like. Big up di athletes!
landmark.enter.Devon House: Devon House! George Stiebel mansion — first black millionaire in Jamaica build dis in 1881. RESPECT!
Devon House ice cream — di sweetest ting on Hope Road since 1881. Pull over if yuh can, brethren!
See di big white mansion? Devon House! Jamaica history and di best ice cream alive — two in one!
landmark.enter.Half Way Tree Clock Tower: Half Way Tree Clock Tower — 1813! Older than independence, older than everything round here!
Di clock tower at di crossroads — halfway between Port Royal and Spanish Town from long time. Every Kingston person know dis spot!
landmark.enter.Flat Bridge: Flat Bridge! One lane, nuh guardrail, pure faith — most exciting bridge in Jamaica! Nuh look down!
Rio Cobre running wild under Flat Bridge — historic crossing, no joke. Tek it slow!
Historic Flat Bridge — flood come, flood go, di bridge remain. Jamaica resilience right deh so!
landmark.enter.Faith's Pen: FAITH'S PEN! Jerk chicken, roast yam, festival — di best roadside stop on di whole island! Pull over!
Every driver who pass through here know: yuh nuh bypass Faith's Pen. It's tradition, brethren!
Faith's Pen cookshop smell reaching into di car — how yuh going drive past dat without stopping?!
landmark.enter.Dunn's River Falls: DUNN'S RIVER FALLS! Journey done, brethren — yuh drive from Airport to Ochi. RESPECT!
Di famous climbable waterfall — journey's end. Time fi cool down inna di water, yuh deserve it!
Dunn's River! Every tourist climb it, every Jamaican proud a it. Yuh reach, star — BIG UP!
pothole.burst: Aye! Dat pothole eat yuh tyre — classic Jamaica road!
Road nuh business wid yuh tyre — yuh haffi slow down!
Yuh tyre gone! Di road a punish yuh fi speeding, driver!
tyre.fixed: Back on di road! Watch di next pothole, star!
Tyre good again — drive careful dis time, nuh?
